name: Cable Curl (standing low-pulley biceps curl with straight bar)
camera: Side three-quarter view facing right, showing athlete standing facing a low cable pulley
equipment: Low cable pulley station with short straight-bar attachment
positionA: Left panel: Athlete stands tall facing the low pulley with feet shoulder-width apart, arms extended down in front of thighs holding straight bar with supinated underhand grip; cable runs taut from floor pulley to bar (start position).
positionB: Right panel: EXACT SAME standing posture and cable tower. Athlete curls bar upward to shoulder height by flexing elbows; elbows stay pinned tight beside ribcage; upper arms remain vertical and motionless; peak biceps contraction.
mechanics: Bilateral elbow flexion against constant cable tension. Torso remains upright and motionless throughout.
avoid: Do not swing torso backward, no drifting elbows forward, no extra limbs, no text/labels/arrows.

Both poses show the same equipment and geometry
